Domain targets: 4.3 lifelong technical and vocational learning, 4.4 relevant skills for decent jobs, 8.2 productivity through innovation, 8.5 full and productive employment.

data_entry_clerk.reason: Reskilling clerical workers before their tasks are automated keeps them in full and productive employment.
data_entry_clerk.reason_ms: Melatih semula pekerja perkeranian sebelum tugasan mereka diautomasikan memastikan mereka kekal dalam pekerjaan yang penuh dan produktif.
